text:
In 2013 the Royal Canadian Mint’s **highest‑mintage circulation coin** was the **$1 “Loonie”** – 120 330 000 pieces were struck.  

The reverse (back) side of that coin carries the design known as *“The Loonie.”*  The primary image on that side is a **Canadian common loon (bird)**, rendered by artist Robert‑Ralph Carmichael.  The loon is the defining visual element on the reverse of every $1 circulation coin minted in 2013.
